# Franchise KI
> Franchise KI connects entrepreneurs with the right franchise opportunity for their budget, lifestyle, and goals. We specialize in franchise discovery, matching, funding guidance, and education.

## About
Franchise KI is an AI-powered franchise consulting platform serving aspiring business owners across the United States.

## Services
- Franchise discovery and AI-powered matching
- Franchise funding guidance and SBA loan education
- Franchise due diligence consulting
- Access to 450+ franchise brands across all industries
